derivation_premises: Folding in close and spreading apart are two positions of the same support.
obligations.statement: Three distinguishable supports exist, each with a folded position adjacent to the body and a deployed position away from it.

derivation_premises: A support that stays attached while moving is connected by something that permits the motion and prevents separation.
obligations.statement: Each support is connected to the body by a relation permitting exactly the motion between those two positions.

derivation_premises: Two valid end positions say nothing about the path between them.
Coming apart while opening is a loss of connection at an interior point.
obligations.statement: A continuous path connects the folded and deployed positions in both directions, with every component connected at every point along it.

derivation_premises: Three coincident or collinear contacts bound no area, so no footprint exists.
obligations.statement: In the deployed configuration the three ground contacts bound a non-zero area.

derivation_premises: Staying open on its own is the absence of a required holding action.
obligations.statement: The deployed configuration persists without continuous user support.

derivation_premises: Fold back, twist aside and come off name three freedoms; move in some other direction names the rest.
A freedom that is neither intended nor prevented is available.
obligations.statement: In the deployed configuration, for every support, every rigid-body freedom is either intended or prevented.

derivation_premises: Something deliberate before folding means folding does not begin without it.
An action that changes nothing is not a release.
obligations.statement: Folding is unavailable until a deliberate user action is performed, and that action makes it available.

derivation_premises: A component that must be taken off is a loose piece the user has to keep.
obligations.statement: Every normal component remains attached through the whole cycle, and no ordinary step requires removing one.

derivation_premises: Compactness with no stated size is not absolutely evaluable but is relationally evaluable.
A folded envelope no smaller than the deployed one has not folded.
obligations.statement: The folded configuration is smaller than the deployed one in at least one storage-relevant extent.

derivation_premises: A holding region that cannot be reached cannot receive an object.
obligations.statement: A region is offered to carry an object and is reachable in the deployed configuration.

derivation_premises: An unreacted load accelerates the body carrying it.
obligations.statement: The object's load reaches a reaction site through a connected path.

derivation_premises: No tools, motor or equipment means every step is performed on the product alone.
obligations.statement: No participant outside the product appears in any operational step.

derivation_premises: A repeatable cycle cannot contain a one-way step.
obligations.statement: No step of the cycle is irreversible.

unresolved.decision: how the deployed configuration is maintained
unresolved.why_open: Six principle families maintain a configuration and the requirements name none. They are not equivalent for this pipeline: three depend on claims no available evidence route can establish, which is a fact about the evidence and not a reason to prefer the others.

unresolved.decision: whether the supports move together or independently
unresolved.why_open: The requirements state only that all three end up spread apart. Coupled and independent motion both satisfy that, and the choice changes what the deliberate release must act on.

alternatives: no quantitative acceptance for the deployed hold
unresolved.decision: what disturbance the deployed configuration must survive
unresolved.why_open: Being knocked is named as the reason for wanting a deliberate release and carries no magnitude, so no maintenance principle can be shown adequate against it.

unresolved.decision: whether the product arrives folded or deployed
unresolved.why_open: The requirements do not say, and the answer constrains the assembly order because some maintenance principles cannot be assembled in one of the two configurations.
